items.text:
Blender to Dreamina in one click — this workflow is getting crazy. 👀

I started with a clay render, brought it into Dreamina with the Clay Renderer Plugin, and used Seedance 2.5 to turn it into the final cinematic shot while keeping the original structure and camera movement.

Dreamina renders what GPT-6 Astra builds: Clay Renderer Plugin brings Blender in, Seedance 2.5 finishes it. Both Seedance 2.5 & Seedance 2.0 at the most competitive price.

From clay → final render. No complicated export/import workflow.

#Dreamina #DreaminaPartner #DreaminaGPT6

items.text:
Colombia está viva.
Y queríamos verla así: salvaje, inmensa y cinematográfica.

Nada de esto fue filmado. Todo fue generado con IA, dirigido escena por escena.
Pero la fauna sí es real, y es nuestra:

🐸 La rana dorada, endémica del Pacífico
🐻 El oso de anteojos, el único oso de Suramérica
🐆 El jaguar del Amazonas
🦅 El cóndor de los Andes

Si sientes que Colombia se ve así, compártelo.

Esto es lo que enseñamos en nuestro próximo workshop: dirigir con IA hasta que se sienta real. Comenta WORKSHOP y te llega la info.

#colombia #faunacolombiana #wildlife #ia #cinematic

items.text: I just had a realization when I was baking alone this weekend in the middle of the night…we’re one of the only specialty macaron shops left here in the Bay Area: shout out to @officialfancyflavors to being one of them 🥹 back when I started making macarons in 2012, there were so many and they inspired me to open my own. A lot has changed since then, including having to pivot our menu and business. Macarons may not be the top selling item anymore, but they’re the reason why we’re here ❤️ thank you for your support throughout the years! #alwaysyoursbakerycafe #macaronshop #CapCut

items.text: Taking you behind the scenes of making our premium matcha lattes, our number 1 best selling drink is our banana pudding matcha latte. 🍵 we source our matcha from Marukyu Koyamaen, and we hand whisk it in big batches. When we went viral last year, we kept hand whisking to order, which resulted in some bad reviews because it took too long. That’s why we decided to batch it with milk, and milk stops the oxidation process. Raise your hand if you love our matcha lattes like I do! 🙋‍♀️ #alwaysyoursbakerycafe #matchalatte #marukyukoyamaen #bayareamatcha
